subject: planner: implement Clone for PhysicalIndexJoin (#60020)
summary: Implements `Clone` for `PhysicalIndexJoin` and `PhysicalIndexHashJoin` so `SafeClone` succeeds and parallel `Apply` can clone IndexJoin-based inner plans; updates planner tests to assert no parallel-apply cloning warnings and adds clone coverage for `PhysicalIndexJoin`. Reviewed the clone implementations against how parallel apply invokes cloning and found no remaining High/Blocker correctness/semantics issues in this commit.
